title: Missouri homeowners win $47,500 after sellers block $272,500 sale over a repaid property loan fight
summary_full: Joseph and Brenda Barber encountered significant challenges while trying to sell their home due to a lien refusal. The initial sellers alleged unpaid funds, prompting the Barbers to initiate legal action. The Missouri Court of Appeals supported the trial court's ruling, granting the Barbers compensation for tortious interference. With evidence confirming the loan's full repayment, the trial court must now assess further attorney fees for the Barbers.
